args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from this BASE_URL. Users are reporting that password reset emails link to localhost, which means PUBLIC_URL is apparently not being set/read correctly in the deployed environment.

Proposed change: ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured and populated in all deployment environments (e.g. via the config module rather than a direct process.env read, consistent with how other settings like config.auth.resetTokenTtlMinutes are sourced), and have templates.ts fail loudly (or at least log a warning) if no production base URL is configured, instead of silently falling back to localhost. This prevents a misconfigured environment from silently producing broken links in password reset, rollup, and export emails.
